# mergegateway_blocklist_rule (Resource)

Manages a blocklist rule: which end customers, providers or models the organization's requests may not use (`block`), or the only providers or models some customers may use (`pin`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Keep every request away from one provider.
resource "mergegateway_blocklist_rule" "no_deepseek" {
  providers = ["deepseek"]
  reason    = "Not approved by security review"
}

# Let two end customers use only OpenAI's GPT-4o models.
resource "mergegateway_blocklist_rule" "acme_pin" {
  rule_type    = "pin"
  customer_ids = ["acme-prod", "acme-staging"]
  models       = ["openai/gpt-4o", "openai/gpt-4o-mini"]
  reason       = "Contractual model restriction"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `customer_ids` (List of String) The end customers the rule applies to. Kept in the order given. Defaults to none.
- `models` (List of String) The models the rule matches, such as `openai/gpt-4o`. Kept in the order given. Defaults to none.
- `providers` (List of String) The providers the rule matches, such as `openai`. Kept in the order given. Defaults to none.
- `reason` (String) Why the rule exists, up to 500 characters. Defaults to none (`""`).
- `rule_type` (String) `block` denies requests that match the rule: it needs at least one of `customer_ids`, `providers` and `models`. `pin` lets the listed customers use only the listed providers or models: it needs `customer_ids` plus `providers` or `models`. Defaults to `block`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the rule was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The rule's ID.
- `updated_at` (String) When the rule was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a blocklist rule by its ID.
terraform import mergegateway_blocklist_rule.no_deepseek 4b5c6d7e-8f9a-4b0c-8d1e-2f3a4b5c6d7e
```
